ValidationRule.description: Ensures that users cannot create hospitalization record without date of admission. This maintains data integrity by requiring key healthcare cost details before overriding total cost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Setup.Data_Migration_Check__c.Bypass_Flow_Validations__c = FALSE && ISBLANK(Source_System_ID__c) &&
AND( RecordType.Name = "Hospitalization", ISNULL( Date_of_Admission__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter some valid input. Input is not optional.
